claims.claim: NuScale disclosed in June 2026 that Paragon was awarded final design work for the module protection system and that certain components for 12 NuScale Power Modules were already in production.

factors.name: SMR commercialization progress
factors.basis: supplier design completion and component production are tangible movement beyond conceptual development

risks.risk: Component production does not establish a completed plant, binding customer economics, construction schedule, or profitable deployment.

causalEdges.mechanism: supplier engineering and component production advance physical implementation
causalEdges.falsifier: program delays, customer cancellations, licensing/construction setbacks or cost escalation prevent deployment

unknowns.unknown: Binding revenue recognition and project-level economics for the 12 modules are not established by this supplier announcement.

claims.claim: The same June 2026 supplier milestone supports evidence that NuScale is progressing detailed safety-system engineering while components for a 12-module set are in production, but it does not by itself prove customer-funded deployment or near-term revenue.

factors.name: execution evidence quality
factors.basis: physical engineering progress is real, while commercial conversion remains unproven by this source

risks.risk: Pre-revenue/project-finance and dilution risk must be evaluated independently from technical progress.

causalEdges.mechanism: completed detailed protection-system design reduces one implementation dependency
causalEdges.falsifier: downstream project financing, licensing or construction fails despite component progress

unknowns.unknown: Exact ATM capacity, current cash burn, binding customer commitments and deployment economics require Alpha underwriting and are not inferred here.
